summary: Grant Park Futures Fund Limited Partnership filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its advisory contract with Commodity Trading Advisor Episteme Capital Partners (UK) LLP terminated effective November 1, 2026; Episteme, which managed roughly 20% of Grant Park's net assets as of September 30, 2026, no longer acts as a CTA. No price, premium or consideration was stated. The remaining CTAs—EMC Capital Advisors, Quantica Capital AG and Sterling Partners Quantitative Investments LLC—will absorb the reallocated assets. This is a routine manager transition rather than a special situation; watch for reallocation execution and any performance impact from the shift.
